claims: Continue continuous ST-segment and cardiac rhythm monitoring for ischemia and arrhythmia surveillance.
Reassess and manage severe pain (reported 8/10) with the existing analgesic regimen, including IV hydromorphone as ordered, and reassess response.
Monitor oxygen saturation and titrate supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above the 88% desaturation limit.
Recheck serum potassium and magnesium and continue electrolyte replacement as ordered, with follow-up basic metabolic panel.
Obtain repeat blood glucose monitoring via fingerstick and continue insulin/glucose management per orders.
Reassess neurologic status and delirium risk with CAM-ICU and Richmond-RAS at least once per shift.
Continue the existing lactated Ringer's infusion at 100 mL/hour and reassess hemodynamic response.
Continue scheduled IV acetaminophen and pantoprazole as ordered.
Maintain fall and skin-integrity precautions given bedfast/chairfast status, impaired mobility, and Braden score indicating risk.
Reassess pain level and response after each analgesic intervention and document.
